name: Wojciech (Albertus) Otto-Trąmpczyński

events.type: Co-heir of a part of Trąbczyn
events.note: Sued the heirs of Łukom over their new pond, on the Monday before Saints Vitus and Modestus 1589; he held only a part of Trąbczyn and was his nephews' guardian.

notes: Brother of Jan the elder; the guardian of Jan's sons.
